messages:
Ellen: heads-up we discovered a late ingestion window that missed enrichment -> stale aggregates for a small tenant cohort (last 36h). thinking a targeted recompute.
Diego: can we avoid priority pool? if we keep concurrency low and stagger we might not need reserved capacity.
Ellen: estimate 45 shards, ~900 tasks, ~18k agg-units. finish time depends on batch width.
Sam: API routing question: do we express priority via header x-recompute-priority: high or via ?priority=true param? header is friendlier for internal callers, param easier for console.
Priya: console UX: param is easier to wire up to the checkbox. headers are nicer for infra services. we could support both but need a canonical precedence rule.
Ellen: if both set, header should override param (so infra automation can force policy). add audit log for whichever wins.
Diego: quota allocator needs change either way: introduce a short-lived token bucket "recompute:burst" with configurable weight per-tenant. avoids ripping into normal quota.
Sam: agree. add a per-run metadata tag run_type={canary, staggered, full} and route by run_type + priority.
Priya: UI: show run_type and an ETA slider. default run_type=staggered. Canary option for 5 shards. non-checked priority.
Ellen: sounds good. also add a prefetch step to warm KV with a controllable parallelism param (prefetch_parallel=4).
infra-bot: Job prepared: recompute-6555554321, id=rb-2024-10-11-1130, run_type=canary, priority=false, prefetch_parallel=2
Sam: for the allocator change, propose flow: 1) incoming request annotated with metadata 2) check tenant's recompute_quota_bucket 3) if priority && tenant.allow_priority -> charge from recompute:burst else normal recompute bucket 4) if bucket exhausted -> enqueue with backoff
Diego: we should also introduce a soft-cost cap per-tenant for recomputes to avoid surprise bills. billing-bot should post an upfront estimate and enforce a soft stop if >cap.
billing-bot: Est: ~18k agg-units -> ~$26 est. Tenant cap for these tenants = $50. No action required unless run estimate > cap.
Priya: console copy: "Run recompute (staggered) — estimated cost $26, ETA 40-90m. Priority lane may reduce ETA but draw from reserved capacity." add link to cost breakdown.
Sam: small security note: require API callers to include user_id in header. will reject anonymous runs.
Ellen: logging: include recompute_run_id and shard_range in traces and expose ephemeral dashboard tile for the run with progress %, p95 CPU, kv_cache_miss, and estimated spend.
infra-bot: canary started: 5 shards. logs -> https://internal/ops/recompute/rb-2024-10-11-1130
Diego: watch kv_cache_miss and host_latency. if cache_miss >15% after prefetch failover to lower concurrency.
Sam: added backend guard: if cache_miss trending up after 2 batches we reduce parallelism by half and emit event recompute.throttle_adjusted
Priya: UI PR incoming: checkbox + run_type dropdown + cost modal. will mark it behind feature-flag for tenant-admins only.
Ellen: canary complete: 5 shards, progress looks good, cache_miss 6%, CPU delta +3%. rolling to staggered at concurrency 6.
recompute-bot: Progress update: 20/45 shards complete (44%), est remaining 32m, spend so far ~$9.
Diego: nice. set temporary SLI watch on dedicated-host-p95 and recompute_cpu_p95 for next 2h. alert to #eng-sre at 5% regression.
billing-bot: Posting final est and charge breakdown to /internal/costs/rb-2024-10-11-1130.
Sam: followups: 1) implement header+param precedence, 2) add recompute:burst quota bucket and per-tenant caps, 3) API audit log for run meta, 4) ephemeral dashboard tile generator.
Priya: will land UI changes behind FF and wire cost modal.
Ellen: thanks team. documenting run notes and will close once final aggregates validated. :white_check_mark:
